rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Sorry, Gainer. Dragging you along like this.
rows.display_text:
「Sorry, Gainer. Dragging you along like
this.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Don't worry about it. Renton helped me out in that last battle, after all.
rows.display_text:
「Don't worry about it. Renton helped me
out in the last battle, after all.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Besides, if it's the city of Katez, even I can show you around.
rows.display_text:
「Besides, if it's the city of Katez, even
I can show you around.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: But you're kind too, Garrod. Helping Renton run his errand like this.
rows.display_text:
「But you're kind too, Garrod. Helping
Renton run his errand like this.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: It's just something to kill time.
rows.display_text: 「It's just something to kill time.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Word is it's still gonna take time to connect $c's warship to Yapan's ceiling anyway.
rows.display_text:
「Word is it'll still take time to connect
$c's warship to Yapan's ceiling anyway.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: This'll let us speed things up in one go, so the Exodus is practically a success already.
rows.display_text:
「This'll speed things up in one go, so
the Exodus is practically a success
already.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: So, since it's a good chance, I figured I'd show Tiffa the snowfields of Siberia.
rows.display_text:
「Since it's a good chance, I figured I'd
show Tiffa the snowfields of Siberia.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: What's wrong, Tiffa?
rows.display_text: 「What's wrong, Tiffa?」

rows.speaker: Tiffa
rows.en: I don't know... I just feel uneasy... like something bad is about to happen...
rows.display_text:
「I don't know... I just feel uneasy, like
something bad's about to happen...」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Huh...

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: Renton... there's a transmission coming in from Hap.
rows.display_text:
「Renton... there's a transmission coming
in from Hap.」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: Renton?
rows.display_text: 「Renton?」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: This is no time to be getting bashful!
rows.display_text: 「This is no time to be getting bashful!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: It suits you, Renton.
rows.display_text: 「It suits you, Renton.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Yes! This is Renton! Go ahead with your instructions!
rows.display_text:
「Yes! This is Renton! Go ahead with your
instructions!」

rows.speaker: Hanae
rows.en: Kira, Athrun, you two eat plenty of rice balls now.
rows.display_text:
「Kira, Athrun, you two eat plenty of
rice balls now.」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: Y-yes... I'm having some.
rows.display_text: 「Y-yes... I'm having some.」

rows.speaker: Umee
rows.en: Young folks shouldn't hold back. Here now... you can't fight a war on an empty stomach, you know.
rows.display_text:
「Young folks shouldn't hold back. You
can't fight a war on an empty stomach,
you know.」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: Thank you very much.
rows.display_text: 「Thank you very much.」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: ...A lot must have happened, to get here.
rows.display_text:
「...A lot must have happened, to get
here.」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Yeah, well. The world was turned upside down in an uproar, but we've been through about the same.
rows.display_text:
「Yeah, well. The world was turned upside
down, but we've been through about the
same.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: It's been nothing but fighting, day after day, but we made it this far.
rows.display_text:
「Nothing but fighting, day after day,
but we made it this far.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: We even fought among ourselves within $c, and fought against you too...
rows.display_text:
「We even fought among ourselves in $c,
and fought against you too...」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: No one could see tomorrow. Not me, not everyone in $c, not anyone in the whole world...
rows.display_text:
「No one could see tomorrow -- not me,
not everyone in $c, not anyone in the
whole world...」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: To change that, we announced the truth to the world.
rows.display_text:
「To change that, we announced the truth
to the world.」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: After that, it's up to each person how they take it.
rows.display_text:
「After that, it's up to each person how
they take it.」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: And gathering those feelings together, let's carry out the space-time restoration.
rows.display_text:
「Gathering those feelings together, let's
carry out the space-time restoration.」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: Then what if everyone in the world wished for this world to just fall apart?
rows.display_text:
「Then what if everyone in the world
wished this world would just fall apart?」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Maybe then the space-time restoration would fail and every world would end up collapsing.
rows.display_text:
「Maybe then the space-time restoration
would fail, and every world would collapse.」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: If that happens, everything we've done up till now will have been for nothing!
rows.display_text:
「If that happens, everything we've done
till now will be for nothing!」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: If it comes to that, it comes to that. It's not us who decides the world... it's the will of every single person.
rows.display_text:
「If it comes to that, so be it. It's not
us who decides the world -- it's the will
of every single person.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: At this point, that's the only way to look at it.
rows.display_text:
「At this point, that's the only way to
look at it.」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: We did what we had to do. All that's left is for us, too, as one person among the world, to wish for the future.
rows.display_text:
「We did what we had to do. All that's
left is for us too, as one person in the
world, to wish for the future.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Well... that's about all there is to it.
rows.display_text: 「Well... that's about all there is to it.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: But I believe it. That everyone's wishing for the future.
rows.display_text:
「But I believe it. That everyone's
wishing for the future.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Wh-what is it...? Did I... say something weird?
rows.display_text:
「Wh-what is it...? Did I... say something
weird?」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: No... I was just thinking... you're strong.
rows.display_text:
「No... I was just thinking... you're
strong.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Th-that's not true! You're the one who's stuck to the path you believed in, Kira!
rows.display_text:
「That's not true! You're the one who
stuck to your own path, Kira!」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: I was... full of doubt the whole way.
rows.display_text: 「I was... full of doubt the whole way.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: If that's the case, then me and everyone in $c are the same.
rows.display_text:
「If that's the case, then me and
everyone in $c are the same.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: ...Wait, I think we already had this conversation earlier.
rows.display_text:
「...Wait, I think we already had this
conversation earlier.」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Let's cut it out with that kind of talk already.
rows.display_text:
「Let's cut it out with that kind of talk
already.」

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: We've had our share of little misunderstandings with each other, but we've become one.
rows.display_text:
「We've had our share of little
misunderstandings, but we've become one.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Exactly. Apologizing for past mistakes matters, but for now, let's think about the future together.
rows.display_text:
「Exactly. Apologizing for past mistakes
matters, but let's now think about the
future together.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: The future... huh.
rows.display_text: 「The future... huh.」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: Yeah...
rows.display_text: 「Yeah...」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Yeah, that's right. We took the long way around, but now we're walking the same path.
rows.display_text:
「Yeah. We took the long way around, but
now we're walking the same path.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Well... in Renton's case, maybe it was a road he was charging straight down from the very start.
rows.display_text:
「Well... for Renton, maybe it was a road
he was charging straight down from the
very start.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Huh...?

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: He means Eureka. Becoming a source of strength for her was the start of your fight, after all.
rows.display_text:
「He means Eureka. Being a source of
strength for her was the start of your
fight, after all.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Yes...!

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: The bond between you and Eureka... just watching it gives strength to us too.
rows.display_text:
「The bond between you and Eureka... just
watching it gives us strength too.」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: That bond must have been nurtured over a long time.
rows.display_text:
「That bond must have been nurtured over
a long time.」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: Actually, that's not quite how it went.
rows.display_text: 「Actually, that's not quite how it went.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Sure, he's got a full-grown face on him now, but back at the start, he kept pulling off some outrageous blunders.
rows.display_text:
「Sure, he's got a grown-up face now,
but back at the start, he kept pulling
off some outrageous blunders.」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: Is that so...?
rows.display_text: 「Is that so...?」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Good opportunity. Should we tell them about Renton's magnificent debut battle?
rows.display_text:
「Good chance. Should we tell them about
Renton's magnificent debut battle?」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: You mean the story of the big confession in Siberia.
rows.display_text:
「You mean the story of the big
confession in Siberia.」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: That sounds like quite a story.
rows.display_text: 「That sounds like quite a story.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: It's a story you don't need to know!
rows.display_text: 「It's a story you don't need to know!」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: I see... but now that you say that, it makes me want to hear it even more.
rows.display_text:
「I see... but now that you say that, I
want to hear it even more.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: No way! Not this one!
rows.display_text: 「No way! Not this one!」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: You're turning redder and redder.
rows.display_text: 「You're turning redder and redder.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: Nngh... nnngh...!
rows.display_text: 「Nngh... nnngh...!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: (Is he saying that on purpose...? Or is it just natural for him...)
rows.display_text:
（(Is he saying that on purpose...? Or
is it just natural for him...)）

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: (Uh oh... if he's a natural airhead like that... he might be my natural enemy...)
rows.display_text:
（(Uh oh... if he's a natural airhead like
that... he might be my natural enemy...)）

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: I'll tell that story some other time. What's coming up next happened a bit after that... titled 'Renton's First Errand.'
rows.display_text:
「I'll tell that story another time. What's
next happened a bit after that... titled
'Renton's First Errand.'」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Ah... that one!?
rows.display_text: 「Ah... that one!?」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: That sounds interesting too. Alright, go ahead.
rows.display_text:
「That sounds interesting too. Alright, go
ahead.」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: Right on! Got a request, so let's spin a nice groovy number for you!
rows.display_text:
「Right on! Got a request, so let's spin
a groovy number for you!」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: That's right... this was way before the Second Break...
rows.display_text:
「That's right... this was way before the
Second Break...」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: It's a story from back when $c's group was going along with the Exodus of Yapan's ceiling, crossing Siberia...
rows.display_text:
「It's from back when $c's group was
going along with Yapan's ceiling's Exodus,
crossing Siberia...」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: ...A job?
rows.display_text: 「...A job?」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: That's right. We also found out from the last battle that you can handle the Nirvash.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. We found out from the
last battle that you can handle the
Nirvash.」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: Sorry about that, Renton. Seems like we... underestimated you.
rows.display_text:
「Sorry about that, Renton. Seems we...
underestimated you.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: N-no, it's not like that...! I just... got fired up seeing big bro Gainer and went at it without thinking...
rows.display_text:
「N-no, it's not like that...! I just got
fired up seeing big bro Gainer and went
at it without thinking...」

rows.speaker: Stoner
rows.en: That's exactly why we want to entrust you with a job. ...Doggy, bring the item.
rows.display_text:
「That's why we want to entrust you
with a job. ...Doggy, bring the item.」

rows.speaker: Moondoggie
rows.en: Yeah...
rows.display_text: 「Yeah...」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Wh-what is this...?
rows.display_text: 「Wh-what is this...?」

rows.speaker: Stoner
rows.en: Careful! What are you doing!?
rows.display_text: 「Careful! What are you doing!?」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Unbelievable. Who touches that bare-handed, normally...?
rows.display_text:
「Unbelievable. Who touches that
bare-handed, normally...?」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: You do realize that's an extremely dangerous item, right?
rows.display_text:
「You do realize that's an extremely
dangerous item, right?」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: What's going on here!?
rows.display_text: 「What's going on here!?」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: It looks like an ordinary delivery box. But with just this one thing, a whole city could...
rows.display_text:
「Looks like an ordinary delivery box. But
with just this one thing, a whole city
could...」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: A whole city could...! Don't tell me... this is a bomb!?
rows.display_text:
「A whole city could...! Don't tell me...
this is a bomb!?」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Don't ask any more than that... You're better off not knowing.
rows.display_text:
「Don't ask any more than that... You're
better off not knowing.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: This is a request from someone hiding up in Yapan's ceiling.
rows.display_text:
「This is a request from someone hiding
up in Yapan's ceiling.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Due to some grown-up circumstances, we've ended up having to deliver this to a certain person.
rows.display_text:
「Due to some grown-up circumstances,
we've ended up delivering this to a
certain person.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: But...

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: I get it, you're reluctant. If I could help it, I wouldn't want to ask you to do something like this either...
rows.display_text:
「I get it, you're reluctant. If I could
help it, I wouldn't ask you to do
something like this either...」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: But moving the Gekko-Goh would draw way too much attention. We'd have to explain ourselves to the folks in $c too.
rows.display_text:
「But moving the Gekko-Goh would draw
way too much attention. We'd have to
explain to the folks in $c too.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: That's why we've got no choice but to ask you, since you don't stand out. There's no other way but for you to help us...
rows.display_text:
「That's why we've got no choice but to
ask you, since you don't stand out. No
other way but for you to help...」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: I'll do it...! Actually, please let me do it!
rows.display_text:
「I'll do it...! Actually, please let me do
it!」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Huh? For real!? You're such a great guy!
rows.display_text:
「Huh? For real!? You're such a great
guy!」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: Alright... then get changed right away and head out.
rows.display_text:
「Alright... then get changed right away
and head out.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Huh... change into what...?
rows.display_text: 「Huh... change into what...?」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: It's a type of urban camouflage. It'll let you disappear from the enemy's sight.
rows.display_text:
「It's urban camouflage. It'll let you
disappear from the enemy's sight.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: O-okay...
rows.display_text: 「O-okay...」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: I'm entrusting the Nirvash to you. Detailed instructions will be sent straight to your receiver once you're on site. ...Count on you.
rows.display_text:
「I'm entrusting you with the Nirvash.
Details go to your receiver once you're
on site. Count on you.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Yes! I'm... heading out!
rows.display_text: 「Yes! I'm... heading out!」

rows.speaker: Gidget
rows.en: He's gone...
rows.display_text: 「He's gone...」

rows.speaker: Stoner
rows.en: Ain't it nice. A young man who doesn't know how to doubt anything.
rows.display_text:
「Ain't it nice. A young man who doesn't
know how to doubt anything.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Now then, everyone... it's time for Gekkostate's traditional event...
rows.display_text:
「Now then, everyone... it's time for
Gekkostate's traditional event...」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: The rookie's first errand... we're gonna show you every last secret behind it. Let the top-secret prank operation begin.
rows.display_text:
「The rookie's first errand... we'll show
you every last secret behind it. Let the
top-secret prank op begin.」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: Doggy... don't screw up the filming this time.
rows.display_text:
「Doggy... don't screw up the filming this
time.」

rows.speaker: Moondoggie
rows.en: I get it. I'll do it right this time.
rows.display_text: 「I get it. I'll do it right this time.」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: Last time's prank got ruined because you, the cameraman, got spotted by Renton before the operation even started.
rows.display_text:
「Last time's prank got ruined because
you, the cameraman, got spotted by
Renton before the op even started.」

rows.speaker: Moondoggie
rows.en: S-sorry about that...
rows.display_text: 「S-sorry about that...」

rows.speaker: Gidget
rows.en: But Renton's kind of funny, isn't he. He got all touched, thinking Doggy came along because he was worried about him, when Doggy was actually just there to film him screwing up...
rows.display_text:
「Renton's funny, though -- touched that
Doggy came worried, when Doggy was
really just filming his screw-ups.」

rows.speaker: Gidget
rows.en: He even started calling Doggy 'big bro' because of it.
rows.display_text:
「He even started calling Doggy 'big bro'
because of it.」

rows.speaker: Moondoggie
rows.en: That's a real pain, all that!
rows.display_text: 「That's a real pain, all that!」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Well, it's fine, isn't it. Renton's found himself a new big brother in Gainer now too.
rows.display_text:
「Well, it's fine. Renton's found himself a
new big brother in Gainer now too.」

rows.speaker: Moondoggie
rows.en: Ah, yeah...
rows.display_text: 「Ah, yeah...」

rows.speaker: Stoner
rows.en: Alright, get going, Doggy. Make sure you send us that top-secret treasure footage in full.
rows.display_text:
「Alright, get going, Doggy. Send us that
top-secret treasure footage in full.」

rows.speaker: Gidget
rows.en: I'll go call over everyone in $c who looks like they've got time to kill.
rows.display_text:
「I'll go call everyone in $c who looks
like they've got time to kill.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Don't let Ken-Goh catch you. If he finds out we're messing with the rookie, we're in for a lecture.
rows.display_text:
「Don't let Ken-Goh catch you. If he
learns we're messing with the rookie,
we're in for a lecture.」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: Alright, we're counting on you, Renton. Show us the ultimate cure for boredom.
rows.display_text:
「Alright, count on you, Renton. Show us
the ultimate cure for boredom.」
